title: Data Store Memory
text: Define data store, {Data store name} sets Name for data store; {Rename All} sets the option to rename data store throughout model, {Data store reference} sets the to access the memory defined in higher-level, {Corresponding Data Store Read/Write blocks} sets the path to connected Data Store Read/Write blocks block, {Initial value}, {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Data type} sets the output data type Inherit, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Dimensions (-1 to infer from Initial value)} sets the dimensions of data store, {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} sets the option to interpret vectors as 1-D, {Signal type} sets the complexity of data store values, {Share across model instances} sets the option to allow Model blocks to read from the same data, {Data store name must resolve to Simulink signal object} sets the option to resolve data store name to Simulink signal, {Detect Read Before Write} sets the action when model attempts to read data before writing in current time step, {Detect Write After Read} sets the action when block attempts to write after reading in same time step, {Detect Write After Write} sets the action when model writes twice in same time step, {Log data store data} sets the option to log data store data, {Logging name} sets the name associated with logged signal data Use data store, {Limit data points to last} sets the option to discard all but last N data and {Decimation} sets the option to log every N th data point. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Data store name
params.values: Name for data store A (default) | character vector | string

params.name: Rename All
params.values: Option to rename data store throughout model button

params.name: Data store reference
params.values: To access the memory defined in higher-level model off (default) | on

params.name: Corresponding Data Store Read/Write blocks
params.values: Path to connected Data Store Read/Write blocks block path

params.name: Initial value
params.values: Initial value of data store 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | string | Enum: | Simulink.ImageType(480,640,3)

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Dimensions (-1 to infer from Initial value)
params.values: Dimensions of data store -1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Interpret vector parameters as 1-D
params.values: Option to interpret vectors as 1-D on (default) | off

params.name: Signal type
params.values: Complexity of data store values auto (default) | real | complex

params.name: Share across model instances
params.values: Option to allow Model blocks to read from the same data store off (default) | on

params.name: Data store name must resolve to Simulink signal object
params.values: Option to resolve data store name to Simulink signal object off (default) | on

params.name: Detect Read Before Write
params.values: Action when model attempts to read data before writing in current time step warning (default) | none | error

params.name: Detect Write After Read
params.values: Action when block attempts to write after reading in same time step warning (default) | none | error

params.name: Detect Write After Write
params.values: Action when model writes twice in same time step warning (default) | none | error

params.name: Log data store data
params.values: Option to log data store data off (default) | on

params.name: Logging name
params.values: Name associated with logged signal data Use data store name (default) | Custom

params.name: Limit data points to last
params.values: Option to discard all but last N data points 5000 | non-zero integer

params.name: Decimation
params.values: Option to log every N th data point 2 (default) | integer
